node.statement: Finite-complex step: if the realization |K| of a simplicial complex is compact, then K is finite. Indeed the open stars St°(v), over vertices v of K, form an open cover of |K|; a vertex w belongs to St°(v) exactly when w=v. A finite subcover therefore contains the star of every vertex, so K has finitely many vertices; its simplices are finite subsets of that finite vertex set, hence there are finitely many simplices.
